preconditions.description: Attacker must hold some amount of the PocongNFT token to perform transfers

violation_target.exploit_hint: The functions excludeFromFee, includeInFee, and enableAllFees are missing the onlyOwner modifier, allowing any user to call them. First, call excludeFromFee with your address to remove all fees on your transfers. Then perform token transfers to avoid paying taxes, liquidity fees, burn fees, and dev fees. You can also call includeInFee on other addresses to force them to pay fees, or manipulate fee settings via enableAllFees to disrupt normal contract operations. This allows you to trade tokens without the normal fee deductions, giving you an economic advantage.

attempts.vulnerability_analysis: The functions excludeFromFee, includeInFee, and enableAllFees lack the onlyOwner modifier, allowing any user to call them. By calling excludeFromFee on our own address, we can avoid all fees (tax, liquidity, burn, dev) when transferring tokens. This gives us an economic advantage when trading tokens, which we can convert to increased ETH balance.
attempts.attack_strategy: 1. Get initial PocongNFT tokens by buying from the Uniswap pair. 2. Call excludeFromFee(attacker) to remove fees. 3. Sell tokens back to the pair without paying fees, receiving more ETH than we would have with fees. 4. Profit from the fee avoidance.
attempts.step_by_step_plan: 1. Set up the test with a fork of the network. 2. Get some initial ETH using deal(). 3. Buy PocongNFT tokens from the Uniswap pair (paying fees initially). 4. Call excludeFromFee(attacker) to exclude ourselves from fees. 5. Sell tokens back to the pair (now without fees). 6. Verify we have more ETH than our initial investment.
